items.t: “韓금융사 7곳 뚫은 ‘아르텍스’, 北-中조직 5곳도 써”
items.d: 한국 금융사 7곳 연쇄 해킹에 쓰인 중국어권 인공지능(AI) 모의 해킹 도구 ‘아르텍스(ARTEX)’를 중국의 전문 해킹 조직 ‘솔트 타이푼’도 사용하는 것으로 조사됐다. 이곳은 2024년 미국 통신사 최소 9곳을 뚫고 당시 대선 후보였던 도널드 트럼프 대통령의 휴대전화를 노린 배후로 지목된 조직이다. 마이크로소프트(MS)는 25일(현지 시간) 보안 블로그에서 아르텍스를 쓰는 해킹 조직으로 솔트 타이푼 등 6곳을 꼽았다. 중국계가 ‘크리스털 타이푼’과 ‘스톰-0940’을 더해 3곳, 북한이 ‘오닉스 슬리트’와 ‘펄 슬리트’ 등 2곳이다. 나머지는 지난달 금융사를 노린 캄보디아 거점 범죄 조직 ‘스톰-3358’이다. 올 7월 보안 점검용으로 공개된 프로그램인 아르텍스가 넉 달 만에 국가 배후 해커와 범죄 조직

items.fullText: Come for the Games, Stay for the Community With GeForce NOW Save 30% with the Black Friday membership sale, claim a ‘War Thunder’ reward and explore 12 new games this week. November 26, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Good games bring people together. This GFN Thursday, GeForce NOW is celebrating the members, creators and community moderators who turn every session into something worth sharing. From friendships formed in online lobbies to new worlds explored on everyday devices, GeForce NOW Ambassadors share their reasons to love cloud gaming. Those ready to find their own can get 30% off six-month Performance and Ultimate memberships in the Black Friday sale and a special seasonal offer through Amazon Fire TV Sticks. Plus, War Thunder gets a new look with NVIDIA DLSS 5 for Ultimate members and a Ready for Battle Pack reward is now available across all membership tiers. Rounding out the week, 12 new games join the GeForce NOW library . The Gamers Behind the Cloud Behind every screenshot, helpful tip and play session is a gamer with a story. GeForce NOW Ambassadors share what keeps them playing. items.fullText: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs NVIDIA and Microsoft expand tools for enterprises to customize AI models and deploy applications across cloud and local infrastructure. November 19, 2026 by Dave Salvator 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA and Microsoft are extending their full-stack collaboration to help organizations build, customize and deploy intelligent applications — from next-generation infrastructure on Azure to industrial systems and Windows PCs. At Microsoft Ignite , the companies are expanding access to Azure virtual machines powered by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, as well as adding customer availability to NVIDIA open models and customization capabilities through Microsoft Foundry, and new options for running AI at the edge, where businesses generate and use their data. Microsoft is also using NVIDIA technologies to accelerate its own models and services, including NVIDIA Dynamo inference software for post-training and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs for Bing search models. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Running in Azure NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems are running in Azure data centers , providing infrastructure designed for demanding reasoning, agentic applications, and large-scale model training and inference. Microsoft and NVIDIA are also collaborating to extend confidential computing to bare-metal and rack-scale AI infrastructure. The work will help protect sensitive models and data while they are being processed, supporting organizations that need to work with proprietary or regulated information. NVIDIA Confidential Computing and attestation help customers verify the computing environment before releasing sensitive models, data or keys. As AI workloads span more interconnected accelerators, the companies are working to extend those protections across the AI factory infrastructure. items.fullText: Lambda Boosts AI Factory Resiliency and Efficiency With NVIDIA Photonics November 16, 2026 by Brian Sparks 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! To train an AI model, thousands of GPUs have to work together, requiring a network that’s fast, efficient and resilient. Lambda is tackling the network piece of the puzzle with NVIDIA Photonics co-packaged optics (CPO) switches. The cloud provider is using the switches to connect NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 racks with more than 10,000 GPUs, delivering lower power, higher resiliency and longer mean time between interruptions (MTBI) to an AI factory at scale. “Networking has to keep pace with the demands of increasingly large AI clusters,” said Dave Ward, president of cloud services at Lambda. “Bringing co-packaged optics into a deployment of this scale is an important step toward building the infrastructure needed to support the next generation of AI.” Read All NVIDIA Announcements From SC26 In the company’s tests using the switches, network latency — the time needed for moving data — dropped by about 4% at rack scale and by up to about 10% at pod scale. Across rack, scalable unit and pod configurations, the network maintains the same throughput as conventional pluggable optics. Delivering Power Efficiency and Resiliency at Scale Improving power efficiency and resiliency matters because the network sits at the center of AI factory productivity. In a large training job, one interrupted link can stall thousands of GPUs. With agentic inference, one network disruption can introduce cascading latency effects on many agents. Every interruption costs time, and every watt spent on networking is a watt not available for compute. NVIDIA Photonics addresses both power efficiency and resiliency. By replacing pluggable transceivers with co-packaged optical engines on the switch package, it delivers up to 5x better power efficiency and up to 15x higher reliability than conventional pluggable optics. items.fullText: A New Dawn in the Cloud: ‘Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV’ Is Coming to GeForce NOW Plus, catch NVIDIA DLSS 5 updates for ‘War Thunder’ and ‘Where Winds Meet,’ and dive into ‘Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen,’ alongside 10 new games. November 12, 2026 by GeForce NOW Community 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Rally the ranks this GFN Thursday. Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV is coming to GeForce NOW , allowing players to experience the battle for Kronus through cloud gaming. There’s more on the horizon, with NVIDIA DLSS 5 technology coming to War Thunder and Where Winds Meet . Meanwhile, Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen brings new tales and encounters, alongside 10 games joining the GeForce NOW library this week. Kronus Calls for Reinforcements Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV , developed by KING Art Games and published by Deep Silver, is coming to GeForce NOW. Launching on Steam Thursday, Dec. 3, the real-time strategy game returns to the series’ roots with large-scale battles, base building and a renewed fight for planet Kronus. Command the Space Marines, Orks, Necrons or the Adeptus Mechanicus, which makes their series debut. Build a base, secure resources and customize squads to the conflict across more than 70 campaign missions, playable solo or in co-op mode. The Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes offer more ways to put tactics to the test. GeForce NOW will bring the action to supported PCs, Macs, handhelds and other devices, with game downloads and updates handled in the cloud. Save the storage space for everyday essentials and planning for the next offensive. Wishlist the game on Steam , and stay tuned to GFN Thursday to prepare for launch. DLSS 5 Keeps on Coming NVIDIA DLSS 5 continues to evolve, with Gaijin Entertainment’s War Thunder and Everstone Studio’s Where Winds Meet next to receive support for the technology with the 3D-Guided Neural Rendering feature.
